reviews.title: The best value 13th gen CPU
reviews.comment:
Absolutely excellent temperatures under load and/or while gaming. 13400 runs slightly faster than 12400F I had previously, but it still stays very cool and stable using Phanteks 240 GlacierOne liquid cooler. I tried 13600K, it was horrible - unstable and extremely hot even with a liquid cooler.
13400(F) is the best value for 13th gen - cheap, stable, easy to cool, runs Cyberpunk 2077 easily paired with RTX 4080. If you are looking for even better value - go with 12400(F).
